body.label: Effect
body.html: Manifest a Phantom through one creature within 4 units. On a success, deal 1 Psychic damage and it cannot make Reactions against you this turn.

surges.html: Ignore 1 Defense granted by a supernatural effect.
Increase this Action's range by 2 units. If you fully manifest through it, the manifestation also gains +1 Defense until your next turn.

rider.title: PHANTOM — FULL MANIFESTATION
rider.html: If you spent at least 4 dice on this Action, as it resolves you may spend 2 additional Mana to fully manifest your Phantom.
